summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of English actress Jenna Coleman, born Jenna-Louise Coleman on 27 April 1986. It highlights her work in British television, especially her roles as Jasmine Thomas in Emmerdale, Clara Oswald in Doctor Who, and Queen Victoria in the ITV drama Victoria. The text is duplicated, and the two versions differ slightly in wording and in the Doctor Who date range.
one_line: Biography of English actress Jenna Coleman, known for Emmerdale, Doctor Who and the ITV drama Victoria.
key_facts: Jenna-Louise Coleman was born on 27 April 1986 and is professionally known as Jenna Coleman.
Jenna Coleman is an English actress; the second version of the note also describes her as an actress and model.
Jenna Coleman is best known for British television work.
Jenna Coleman played Jasmine Thomas in the soap opera Emmerdale, dated 2005 to 2009.
Jenna Coleman played Clara Oswald, companion to the Eleventh and Twelfth Doctors in the science fiction series Doctor Who.
The first version dates Jenna Coleman's Doctor Who run as 2012 to 15; the second version dates it as 2012 to 2015 and 2017.
Jenna Coleman played Queen Victoria in the ITV biographical drama series Victoria.
Victoria is dated 2016 to present in the note.
The note names ITV as the broadcaster of the drama series Victoria.
The note appears twice in near-identical form, with the second copy adding 'and model' and the 2017 Doctor Who date.
